**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — Base Agreement § 15.3 b) (p0274).**

- **Cap basis fails the fallback.** The only monetary cap is 3% of the bill-of-materials value of Products delivered across the entire term — a small fraction of what IBM pays MSL, well short of twelve months' fees and plausibly under six months' fees (walk-away).
- **No carve-outs at all.** MSL's § 15.1 indemnity (third-party IP infringement, legal non-compliance, warranty failures), the § 13.2/AECI confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct all sit inside the cap with no super-cap.
- **Mutuality is fine**, as is the mutual consequential-damages waiver in § 15.3 a) — left untouched.
- **Not flagged:** the one-sided $25,000 limit in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement § 15 caps MSL's remedies against IBM and benefits us.

Redline (validated `ok:true`) makes the smallest edit to the existing sentence: mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' charges and US$1,000,000, plus one "Excluded Claims" sentence placing indemnities, confidentiality/security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement and IBM's payment obligations outside the cap.
